properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.check-template
properties.description: Whether to check that the template exists before rendering it.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.check-template-location
properties.description: Whether to check that the templates location exists.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.enable-spring-el-compiler
properties.description: Enable the SpringEL compiler in SpringEL expressions.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.excluded-view-names
properties.description: List of view names (patterns allowed) that should be excluded from resolution.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.mode
properties.description: Template mode to be applied to templates. See also Thymeleaf's TemplateMode enum.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.prefix
properties.description: Prefix that gets prepended to view names when building a URL.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.reactive.chunked-mode-view-names
properties.description: Comma-separated list of view names (patterns allowed) that should be the only ones executed in CHUNKED mode when a max chunk size is set.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.reactive.full-mode-view-names
properties.description: Comma-separated list of view names (patterns allowed) that should be executed in FULL mode even if a max chunk size is set.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.reactive.max-chunk-size
properties.description: Maximum size of data buffers used for writing to the response. Templates will execute in CHUNKED mode by default if this is set.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.reactive.media-types
properties.description: Media types supported by the view technology.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.render-hidden-markers-before-checkboxes
properties.description: Whether hidden form inputs acting as markers for checkboxes should be rendered before the checkbox element itself.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.servlet.content-type
properties.description: Content-Type value written to HTTP responses.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.servlet.produce-partial-output-while-processing
properties.description: Whether Thymeleaf should start writing partial output as soon as possible or buffer until template processing is finished.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.suffix
properties.description: Suffix that gets appended to view names when building a URL.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.template-resolver-order
properties.description: Order of the template resolver in the chain. By default, the template resolver is first in the chain. Order start at 1 and should only be set if you have defined additional "TemplateResolver" beans.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.view-names
properties.description: List of view names (patterns allowed) that can be resolved.

deprecation.reason: No longer required. To use Thymeleaf without auto-configuration, depend directly on Thymeleaf instead of spring-boot-thymeleaf.
